stories.title: Alexandrova stuns No. 1 Sabalenka in Toronto R16 [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Alexandrova def. No. 1 Sabalenka 7-6(3), 4-6, 6-4 in Toronto R16. World No. 1's title defense is over in two hours and 29 minutes. Alexandrova has now beaten Sabalenka twice. H2H: 5-5. #WTA #NBO2026 #Tennis #TorontoOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Sabalenka had Alexandrova at 3-6, 4-6(3). That wasn't enough. Alexandrova closed 6-4 in the decider to end the world No. 1's Canadian Open. She's cracked the Sabalenka code — twice. The only other time was Doha 2025. #WTA #NBO2026 #Tennis

stories.title: Swiatek exorcises Roland Garros ghost vs. Kostyuk [TIER 1]

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: Iga Swiatek loses the first set 3-6 to Kostyuk — the player who knocked her out at Roland Garros. Then Swiatek wins 12 of the next 15 games. Final: 3-6, 6-1, 6-2. "I'm in a different place for sure." #WTA #NBO2026 #Tennis #TorontoOpen

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Kostyuk beat Swiatek at Roland Garros in May. On Saturday in Toronto, Swiatek returned the favour — and then some. After the 3-6 first set, she dropped 3 games. Toronto quarterfinals await. #WTA #NBO2026 #Tennis
